descriptionPlain:
The Customer Success Executive is responsible for ensuring that assigned Siteimprove customers are consistently successful in working with Siteimprove. The results of these efforts should be a high retention rate of Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), identification of contract expansion opportunities, and identifying Customers willing to participate in promotional projects such as case studies, testimonials, and reference requests. The primary goal of this role is to ensure the Customer is successfully and continuously finding value with their subscription in a mutually beneficial manner to both the Customer and Siteimprove. 
 
By combining your understanding of the Customer’s definition of success with your expertise in the Siteimprove offerings you will advise our Customers on how they can realize value and best leverage their solutions and services. Doing so time and again will result in you being a trusted advisor and strategic partner for our Customers and their go-to contact for all things Siteimprove. This will also result in other Siteimprove departments looking to you for knowledge about our Customers which you will be willing and able to provide.

lists.content:
• Manage the entire customer lifecycle from post-implementation to retention & expansion
  • Manage a scaled portfolio & identify key industry trends and opportunities to impact customers at scale
  • Meet and exceed overall Customer gross and net retention goals with assigned customers.
  • Work with Customers to understand business objectives, or other key performance indicators, and aid the Customer in achieving their definition of success. 
  • Utilize all available methods and tools for indications of improving or failing Customer health and respond accordingly. Examples include employing risk mitigation tactics or providing expansion leads to the Sales team 
  • Work cross-functionally with key stakeholders in sales, renewals management, services, and marketing
  • Actively participate in knowledge-sharing activities, including but not limited to process improvements and Customer and industry trends. Provide feedback that will improve how Siteimprove works with our Customers. 
  • Maintain practitioner-level knowledge of customer industries as well as product features, advantages, benefits, contract details, and selling points for effective communication.
  • Advocate on behalf of the Customer to other departments to ensure Customer needs are met
  • Keep up-to-date information, status, documentation, and other pertinent details of assigned Customers in Siteimprove’s Customer Success tool.
  • Attend meetings and other company functions necessary to perform duties
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

lists.text: What we will require of you
lists.content:
• Minimum 3 years of experience in Customer Success or equivalent history in increasing Customer satisfaction, adoption, and retention. 
  • Self-starter with a demonstrated record of acquiring knowledge above and beyond what is needed to complete assigned tasks 
  • Strong listening ability and persuasiveness to use appropriate interpersonal styles and communication methods
  • Proven Customer focus experience ensuring the Customer perspective is a driving force behind business decisions and activities
  • Excellent problem-solving and creative thinking skills 
  • Proven ability to be a business advisor by creating valuable business partnerships with Customers
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable results
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills working in a professional environment in Scandinavian languages
  • Strong collaboration and teambuilding skills
  • Excellent, time management, organizational, and planning skills
  • Ability to multi-task and adapt to a fast-paced environment
  • Travel as needed

lists.text: What we will love about you
lists.content:
• Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) experience in a B2B Martech environment
  • Experience in digital marketing 
  • Knowledge of and/or experience with a CRM tool 
  • High-level knowledge of Digital Content Creation, accessibility, Search Engine Optimization, and Digital Analytics 
  • Familiarity with HTML or web content management is a plus

lists.text: In addition, we hope you will appreciate:
lists.content:
At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our UK benefits are designed to help you stay healthy, maintain a healthy work-life balance, and plan confidently for the future.                                                                           
 
Rest and relaxation: 25 days of annual holiday, plus support for flexible and sustainable commuting to our London office.
 
Comprehensive benefits: Private medical coverage through Bupa, wellbeing and employee support services through Canada Life, and a weekly lunch allowance.                                                                                                                                                                             
 
Prepare for the future: Company pension benefits through Aviva to help support your long-term financial goals.

descriptionPlain:
Siteimprove is a global leader in digital accessibility, content optimization, and web governance, empowering organizations to deliver inclusive, high-performing digital experiences. With the launch of Siteimprove.ai, the only enterprise platform unifying content compliance and content performance, we are leading the way in the AI era—where content must perform for both humans and AI.
From accessibility and SEO/AIO to analytics and content intelligence, our Agentic Content Intelligence Platform enables organizations to create, govern, and optimize digital content that is compliant, discoverable, and effective at scale.
We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA Enterprise Sales team, covering the DACH region. In this quota-carrying role, you will drive new business growth across strategic enterprise accounts, partnering with organizations typically ranging from 250M–5B+ in revenue.
You will engage senior stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement to uncover business challenges and deliver measurable outcomes through Siteimprove’s SaaS and AI-powered platform. This is a full-cycle sales role where you will lead everything from prospecting and discovery through to solution alignment, negotiation, and close.
A strong command of German is required, as you will be working closely with customers and prospects across the DACH region. This is a high-impact role within a fast-growing international organization, offering the opportunity to shape how leading enterprises approach accessibility, content performance, and AI-driven digital governance.
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if they don’t meet every requirement. If you are motivated by impact, growth, and working at the intersection of AI, content, and digital experience, we want to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Own the full sales cycle for named enterprise accounts, driving both new logo acquisition and expansion opportunities within your territory
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement
  • Execute a multi-threaded sales approach to navigate complex enterprise buying processes and long sales cycles
  • Identify customer challenges and align Siteimprove’s accessibility, analytics, SEO, and content intelligence solutions to business outcomes
  • Partner closely with internal teams including Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Value Consulting, and Customer Success to deliver tailored, high-impact customer engagements
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce, ensuring disciplined opportunity progression
  • Stay informed on EU and DACH digital accessibility regulations, AI governance trends, and enterprise compliance requirements
  • Represent Siteimprove at industry events, conferences, and regional customer forums across EMEA
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing across the sales organization
    •

lists.text: What we will require of you
lists.content:
• 5+ years of SaaS sales experience with a strong track record in new business and/or account growth
  • Experience selling Martech, digital experience, or related enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Oracle, Demandbase, Amplitude, Braze, 6sense)
  • Fluency in German (written and spoken), with experience selling into the DACH market strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
  • Experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders (CMO, CDO, CIO, and equivalent roles)
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build, forecast, and close large, strategic deals
  • Collaborative mindset with a strong bias for action, learning, and cross-functional partnership
  • High resilience, adaptability, and performance orientation in a fast-paced environment

lists.text: What we will love about you
lists.content:
• Experience selling into regulated or highly governed industries such as financial services, insurance, or public sector
  • Passion for digital accessibility, inclusive design, ESG, or responsible AI
  • Familiarity with value-based selling methodologies (MEDDICC or similar) and consultative enterprise sales approaches

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

lists.text: In addition, we hope you will appreciate:
lists.content:
At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Germany benefits are designed to provide financial security, flexibility, and support for everyday life. 

Rest and relaxation: 30 days of annual leave, plus paid volunteer time to support causes that matter to you.

Comprehensive benefits: Statutory health coverage, digital meal vouchers, workplace glasses support, and monthly work-from-home and mobile phone allowances. 

Prepare for the future: Participation in Germany's statutory pension system, helping support your long-term financial wellbeing.

descriptionPlain:
The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on. 
We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it. 
Tech stack you will be working with 
C# and .NET, TypeScript, React
AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
Event driven services and large scale data pipelines
GitHub Actions for CI and CD
Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC
description:
The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on. 

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it. 

Tech stack you will be working with 

  • C# and .NET, TypeScript, React
  • AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Event driven services and large scale data pipelines
  • GitHub Actions for CI and CD
  • Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

lists.content:
• Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.
  • Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.
  • Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.
  • Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.
  • Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.
  • Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.
  • Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.
  • Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.
  • Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support. 
  • Travel may be required; a valid passport is required
  • Perform other duties as assigned

lists.text: What we will require of you
lists.content:
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.
  • 10 or more years of professional software development experience.
  • 5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.
  • A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.
  • You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.
  • Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.
  • Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.
  • Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.
  • Willingness to work across the stack when the problem calls for it. 
    •

lists.text: What we will love about you
lists.content:
• Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute. 
  • Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data. 
  • Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation. 
  • Experience working in a team distributed across Europe and North America. 
  • You take pride in the work of the team and lead by example. 
  • You are comfortable replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

lists.text: In addition, we hope you will appreciate:
lists.content:
At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.     

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.                                                                                                                                                                                         
Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.                                                                                                                                                                                                             
Prepare for the future: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals.
